programs.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
programs.desc: The famous chef will learn about the cuisine, culture, traditions and history of inhabitants of distant corners of the world.The winner of several Michelin stars goes on exciting expeditions with the passion of an adventurer.To prepare local dishes, you will often need hard-to-find ingredients.To get them, he will even risk encountering poisonous creatures.Gordon Ramsay will travel through the rocky slopes of the Andes, the jungles of Borneo and the wild regions of Cambodia.First, the local masters will tell him their secrets.The Scot will create his own versions of their dishes and then compete in a culinary duel.

programs.title: Lawless Island
programs.desc: The inhabitants of Prince of Wales Island fish, hunt and collect firewood.They have no roads, police or offices, but are threatened by wolves and bears.However, no one is thinking about returning to the city.

programs.title: Mutant Weather
programs.desc: The program presents new weather phenomena caused by climate warming.They cause surprising changes in the world around us, to which we cannot adapt so quickly.

programs.title: Weather Gone Viral 3
